opportunities.title: Research Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submitting; hold an independent research post; must not currently hold another active Research Fund grant; applications limited to one per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Provides up to £5000 for 12 months covering chemicals/equipment, consumables, specialist software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submitting and for the duration of the grant. PhD students or researchers at any career stage, any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers to establish and develop collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations. Funds research visits to collaborators and organising meetings/workshops.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland (ROI) resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based engagement and outreach projects connecting communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences. Open for applications throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026. Prioritises projects reaching under-represented audiences and developing engagement skills.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: You are a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event, covering additional costs incurred for care that they usually provide. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: You are a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; will use funds to cover support or assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support to reduce accessibility challenges when attending professional events, covering costs of specific support such as equipment, services or personal expenses associated with meeting access needs for chemists with disabilities and ongoing health conditions. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.
